decisions.physicalWaxFormat: 17 baseball cards plus 1 Magic Motion trivia card; 36 packs per box.
decisions.vcsPackFormat: 18 total slots so the guaranteed Magic Motion card leaves 17 base slots. A Young Superstars hit replaces another base slot.
decisions.rackExclusiveConversion: Young Superstars Series I: one per rack pack. VCS models a rack as three wax-equivalent packs (three trivia cards per rack), converting to 1:3 VCS packs. This is an intentional channel abstraction, not historical wax odds. Physical rack packs contained 54 baseball cards plus three trivia cards.
decisions.subsets: Reggie Jackson Tribute 500-504; Rookie Prospects 623-647; All-Stars 648-651; 1987 Season Highlights 652-660. All remain in complete Base.
decisions.variations: Eight corrected source error states replace their errors; no separate completion requirement.
decisions.exclusions: Factory-only 5000-set Glossy parallel, promos, box-bottom panels/singles and separately sold Rookie/Traded and Young Superstars Series II products excluded.
decisions.magicMotion: Complete 56-card checklist with historical event teams/dates and titles, no inferred RC labels.
